name: Toyol
description: An undead infant familiar in Malay and Indonesian folklore, kept by a shaman or owner to steal money and small valuables for its master. Belief remains widespread across the Malay Archipelago.

aliases.name: Kuman Thong (cf.)
aliases.meaning: Related Thai child-spirit familiar; not identical

origin: Belief is found throughout the Malay Archipelago and the Malay-Chinese diaspora, including Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapore, Brunei, and southern Thailand.
